items.title: The Neon Terraform provider is now official
items.summary: Infrastructure as code is a great fit for agents. Bigger teams compose Neon with AWS, Cloudflare and more in Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi or Alchemy. That's why kislerdm/neon, the community Terraform provider Dmitry Kisler started in 2022, is now the official neondatabase/neon provider.
items.creator: Andre Landgraf

items.title: Query your WorkOS users in Neon with the WorkOS Sync Engine
items.summary: If your auth data lives in WorkOS but your product data lives in Postgres, answering questions like "which enterprise customers have admins who never set up SSO" meant paging through the WorkOS API and stitching the results together in application code. To fix this, WorkOS has built WorkOS Sync Engine, which mirrors that data into a workos schema in your own database and keeps it current...
items.creator: Carlota Soto
